title: A planned bug's title figure is read from its check's output at planning, not kept from the intake
goal: Planning rewrites a committed bug's title or goal figure (a row count, a share) to the number its check prints on the base, or check warns when the title's figure differs from the premise note's; found in SP-7ff7c5ui: BG-nht352ib was titled '13 of the aliases.csv rows' while its all-rows check printed 21 on the base, as its own plan note recorded
